ownerOnly: This view is only available to owners.
loadFailed: The data could not be loaded.

overview.title: Security
overview.description: Sign-in protection across the whole platform: alerts, failed attempts, blocks. Addresses only appear as shortened pseudonyms.

tiles.criticalAlerts: {count, plural, =0 {none critical} one {# critical} other {# critical}}

overview.chartSummary: {failures, number} failed attempts and {successes, number} successful sign-ins in 48 hours, in 5-minute buckets.
overview.chartEmpty: There were no sign-in events in the last 48 hours.
overview.noTopNetworks: No failed attempts from single networks.

events.title: Sign-in events
events.description: Latest events of the sign-in protection. Accounts, networks and devices only appear as shortened pseudonyms.
events.resolveConfirm: Map this event's pseudonym to an account? This requires a passkey confirmation and is recorded in the audit log.
events.countrySource: Country data: <link>“IP to Country Lite” by DB-IP.com</link> (CC BY 4.0), looked up locally, no IP address stored.

blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.description: Temporary blocks of sources for the sign-in endpoints – never for accounts on known devices, never permanent. A pseudonym is blocked, never an address. Setting, extending and lifting require passkey confirmation.
blocks.unblockConfirm: Lift the block for {subject}? Sign-ins from this source will be possible again.
blocks.ipHelp: Hashed when saved and never stored in plain text.
blocks.readOnly: Only owners can set or lift blocks.
blocks.remainingShare: Remaining share of the block duration
blocks.extendDescription: The block then becomes a manual block (stage 5). Confirmed with a passkey and recorded in the audit log.
blocks.modalDescription: Stage 5. Confirmed with a passkey and recorded in the audit log.
blocks.reasonHelp: Required, e.g. abuse report or incident.

ladder.title: Defence stages
ladder.hint: Stages 1–3: events in the last 24 h · stages 4–5: active blocks

2.title: Limits lowered
2.text: Attempt rate or failure limit exceeded, attempt rejected.

3.title: Extra check
3.text: Unknown devices need an email code or second factor.

4.title: Temporarily blocked
4.text: After repeated hard limits: sign-in endpoints closed for the source.

5.title: Manually blocked
5.text: By a platform admin with reason and expiry.

ladder.durations: Duration per repetition within 7 days: {durations} min
ladder.limits: Automatic at most {automatic} h, manual at most {manual} days

history.title: History, 7 days
history.summary: {sources, plural, =0 {No blocks} one {# source} other {# sources}} with {bars, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}}, {manual, number} of them manual. Repetitions get longer.
history.empty: There were no blocks in the last 7 days.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Currently triggered alert rules of the sign-in protection. The same rules also notify via ntfy.
alerts.empty: No alert rule is currently triggered.

rules.stuffing: Credential stuffing: many failures from many networks
rules.admin_new_device: Platform sign-in from a new device
rules.tenant: Many accounts of one tenant with failures

alerts.acknowledgeConfirm: Acknowledge this warning as seen? It no longer counts as open until it subsides and occurs again. Blocks and notifications stay unchanged.
alerts.ackHelp: Acknowledged warnings stay visible but no longer count in the bell and overview. If a warning occurs again after subsiding, it is open again.
alerts.clearsAt: Clears by itself at {time} if nothing new happens until then (window of {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} after the last event).

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Admin and tenant actions with their outcome.

policy.title: Policies
policy.description: Effective settings of the sign-in protection (display only, without secrets). They are changed in the server configuration.

export.title: Export security data
export.description: JSONL file encrypted with your password. The export is confirmed with a passkey and recorded in the audit log.
export.passwordHelp: At least {min} characters. The file cannot be opened without this password.

subject.title: Account for this event
subject.description: The lookup has been recorded in the audit log. Network and address are never shown.
subject.unknown: No account found: the entered address does not belong to any account or the event is too old.
subject.name: Name

viaKinds.related_event: an earlier event with the same pseudonym
